steps.en: Install the wrapper; FFmpeg itself must already be on your PATH
steps.zh: 装上这个封装；FFmpeg 本体得自己先装好、放进 PATH

steps.en: Open each media file as a stream node
steps.zh: 把每个媒体文件打开成一个流节点

steps.en: Chain filters on the streams, merge branches, end with an output file
steps.zh: 在流上串滤镜、合并分支，最后指定输出文件

steps.en: Call run on the finished graph
Walks the graph and compiles it into one ffmpeg argument list with -filter_complex
steps.zh: 遍历这张图，编译成一条带 -filter_complex 的 ffmpeg 参数

steps.en: Starts the ffmpeg binary as a subprocess and waits for it to exit
steps.zh: 以子进程启动 ffmpeg 二进制，等它跑完

steps.en: Returns once ffmpeg has written the output; a non-zero exit raises ffmpeg.Error
steps.zh: ffmpeg 写完输出就返回；非零退出码抛 ffmpeg.Error

value.en: A trim-concat-overlay graph stays readable, testable Python instead of a hand-escaped -filter_complex string
value.zh: “裁剪—拼接—叠加”这种图写成可读、可测的 Python，不用再手拼转义 -filter_complex 字符串

sources: https://github.com/kkroening/ffmpeg-python#installation (pip install ffmpeg-python; FFmpeg must be on $PATH, not installed by the wrapper)
https://github.com/kkroening/ffmpeg-python/blob/master/ffmpeg/_run.py (get_args adds -filter_complex; run_async uses subprocess.Popen; run raises Error on non-zero retcode)
